Discover the heartwarming and emotionally charged world of *Silver Bay*. This captivating novel plunges readers into a life of escape, following Liza McCullen as she attempts to outrun her past. While the secluded beaches and the close-knit community of Silver Bay offer her the peace and security she cravesâespecially for the sake of her daughter, Hannahâa man's arrival threatens to shatter her fragile tranquility.

When the cultured Englishman, Mike Dormer, arrives as a guest at her auntâs hotel, the quiet rhythm of this idyllic seaside town is abruptly disrupted. With his elegant attire and troubled eyes, Mike has the potential to dismantle everything Liza worked so hard to protect: not only her family business and her favorite spot observing whale migrations, but also her conviction that she can never truly love again.

This beautiful story explores the complexity of connection, proving that sometimes, even when we decide our hearts are closed, fate has other plans. "Love was never more complicated than in this fascinating story," praised the *Daily Mail*.
